summary: Agent rootcause11 downstream integration: connect the accepted Core V4 exact shared-harvest receipt-binding contract to the real AlembicAgent production Evidence Ledger, witness authority, independent reviewer, and key-custody runtime so one physical evidence harvest authorizes the complete two-scale receipt set without duplication or receipt loss. Agent-only; Main remains blocked until this producer lands.
sourceRef: Original Plan Final Completion Definition bullets 6-9; Requirement Design §§10.5, 11.2, 11.6, 11.8, 18.1-18.3, 21; accepted Core result tr-i3-i9-core-shared-harvest-evidence-authority-rootcause11-t1; AlembicCore@8602b9e6dd03a362736118a92cfd4ae24e35661e; AlembicAgent@2bf05831bc95a89347df7e4035bfeadbc93c3c09; blocked Main rootcause10 result
designIntent: Upgrade the existing AlembicAgent durable semantic-review runtime from Core V3 scalar receipt selection to the accepted Core V4 shared-harvest contract. Use Core's `expectedExecutionReceiptBindings` as the sole grouping authority; the Agent Evidence Ledger/witness adapter may authenticate and load the one existing entry/snapshot/witness, but must not choose, collapse, duplicate, or synthesize receipts. Replace `selectExactExecution(... matches.length === 1)` with a set-aware lookup that proves the expected bindings all address the same accepted file execution/witness coordinates, invokes the store once per evidence authority, produces a V4 attestation through `@alembic/core/host-agent-workflows`, and preserves provider independence, cancellation/timeout/permission failures, private key custody, public facade restrictions, legacy paths where explicitly compatible, and the single production Evidence Ledger. Do not modify Core/Main/Plugin/Test/Wakeflow, create a second store/platform, make harvest identity scale-dependent, or drop either obligation/receipt.

required.verify: One clean AlembicAgent commit based exactly on 2bf05831bc95a89347df7e4035bfeadbc93c3c09 and consuming AlembicCore 8602b9e6dd03a362736118a92cfd4ae24e35661e. Report parent/commit/tree/changed files; no Core/Main/Plugin/Test/Wakeflow/vendor edits.

Show from the real current code that `selectExactExecution` collects both legitimate file+repository matches then fails on `matches.length !== 1`, and that the V3 load result asks Agent to choose one receipt/file. Map the repair to Core V4 expected binding-set authority without moving grouping authority back into Agent.

Through supported public package exports and the real Agent production Evidence Ledger/read facet plus witness authority, run one semantic request whose file+repository obligations have two distinct obligationId/receiptHash values but one harvestKey/harvestReceiptHash/fileExecution/evidence entry. Prove exactly one evidence-authority load and one independent reviewer call produce a serialized V4 attestation whose binding union equals both request receipts; verify after fresh-process rehydrate with the Core public V4 verifier/consumer or shared-harvest fixture contract.

Reject missing/extra/duplicate/reordered expected bindings, mixed harvest/file/witness/blob/source coordinates, partial/truncated execution, ledger entry/snapshot rebound, witness-authority mismatch, fake production facet, reused/concurrent execution, malformed reviewer output, provider failure, permission denial, cancellation and timeout. Prove failures occur before attestation success and do not duplicate/mutate the production Evidence Ledger.

Keep AlembicAgent as AI/provider/key-custody/Evidence-Ledger/witness-adapter owner and Core as deterministic binding-set/signature/verifier owner. Public `@alembic/agent/production` exposes the real runtime contract but must not export raw Core mint/store adapters, private keys, process-local registries, or a second evidence platform. Main integration remains downstream.

Run RED then GREEN focused durable semantic runtime, production Evidence Ledger, AgentRuntime and public strict-consumer tests; build:check/build, built public/fresh-process probes, `npm run lint:core-import-boundary`, full `npm run check`, scoped lint/format, git diff --check, and Alembic Guard. Report exact counts and prove any baseline failure is pre-existing and unchanged.

targetTasks.summary: Replace the V3 exact-one scalar selector with a Core-authoritative V4 binding-set integration over the existing production Evidence Ledger/witness path, prove the real two-scale shared-harvest scenario plus failures and fresh-process durability, and return one clean Agent commit.
